title: A Little Card for Saving
paras: In 1910, a small river town had no bank. People kept money at home. A [[boat|boat]] worker named Tomas was [[afraid|afraid]] of losing his coins. He wanted to [[start|start]] a savings club. He put a notice in the town [[newspaper|newspaper]]. On Sunday, eight people met in his kitchen. They put a [[fine|fine]] wooden box in the [[centre|centre]] of the table.

Each person got a small [[card|card]] with their name on it. Every week, they brought a few coins. Tomas wrote the date and the amount on their cards. His sister checked the money and locked the box. People [[sometimes|sometimes]] brought only one coin. That was enough. The club was for people with little money, and everyone could save at their own speed.

After two years, one member, Ada, needed money to visit a [[hospital|hospital]] in another town. She took out her savings and paid for the trip. Later, other members bought shoes or tools with their money. The club made [[life|life]] a little easier. Years later, the town got a bank, but Ada kept her old savings card in a drawer.
zh: 1910年，一座河边小镇还没有银行。人们把钱放在家里。一位名叫托马斯的船工担心自己的硬币会丢失。他想成立一个储蓄会，于是在镇上的报纸上登了一则启事。星期天，八个人来到他家的厨房。他们把一个精致的木箱放在桌子中央。
每个人都领到了一张写着自己名字的小卡片。每周，他们都会带来几枚硬币。托马斯把日期和金额记在各人的卡片上。他的姐妹核对钱数，然后锁上箱子。人们有时只带来一枚硬币。这也足够了。这个储蓄会是为钱不多的人办的，每个人都可以按照自己的节奏存钱。
两年后，一位名叫艾达的会员需要钱去另一个镇的医院。她取出自己的积蓄，支付了这趟行程的费用。后来，其他会员也用存下的钱买了鞋子或工具。储蓄会让生活变得轻松了一点。多年以后，镇上有了银行，但艾达仍把那张旧储蓄卡保存在抽屉里。

q.s: The first club meeting took place in Tomas's home.
q.why: 第一次聚会在托马斯家的厨房举行。

q.s: Members had to save the same amount each week.
q.why: 会员可按自己的节奏存钱，一枚硬币也行。

q.s: Ada travelled to the hospital with her daughter.
q.why: 文章未说明谁陪艾达去医院。
